en.stem: A transmission line Z = (2 + j8) Ω has 10% of the voltage regulation with the lagging load of 0.8. If the load is 0.707 leading, then the V.R. is ________ (Assume the current is same in both cases)
en.quick: For a short-line approximation, voltage regulation is proportional to I(R cosφ + X sinφ) for lagging current, while the reactive term changes sign for leading current. Using the given 10% lagging case to eliminate the common I/V factor gives a negative regulation for 0.707 leading, about −6.63%.

hi.stem: एक पारेषण लाइन Z = (2 + j8) Ω का 0.8 लैगिंग लोड पर वोल्टेज नियमन 10% है। यदि लोड 0.707 लीडिंग हो, तो V.R. ________ होगा (मान लें दोनों स्थितियों में धारा समान है)

gu.stem: એક પારેષણ લાઇન Z = (2 + j8) Ω નું 0.8 લેગિંગ લોડે વોલ્ટેજ નિયમન 10% છે. જો લોડ 0.707 લીડિંગ હોય, તો V.R. ________ થશે (ધારો કે બંને સ્થિતિમાં પ્રવાહ સમાન છે)
